p1: In 1900, three lighthouse keepers vanished... and one of them left his coat behind.
On December 15th, a passing ship saw the lighthouse was dark.
Eleven days later, the relief boat arrived. Nobody was waiting.
Relief keeper Joseph Moore climbed up alone. Gate shut. Door shut.
Inside... nobody. Their beds were empty.
Two sets of oilskins were gone. The third man's coat was still hanging there.
In December... in the North Atlantic... he went out in his shirt sleeves.
At the west landing, a one-ton stone had been moved... and a life buoy was torn away, 110 feet above the sea.
Officially: a huge wave swept all three men away.
But why did the third man go out without his coat? What did he see?
That creepy logbook online? Fake. Written decades later.
